structured_output.what_is_happening: AROS ("American Reserved Oil Supply") is a copy of a very hot ticker. The packet lists same-name AROS tokens at about $1B, $984M, $982M and $405M market cap. One of them (DsJDV...pump) had $1.79M of volume in the last hour and was created about 10 minutes before this pool. This coin is not a pump.fun mint: its address has no "pump" suffix, it shows no launchpad and no migration, and the PumpSwap pool was seeded directly. Pool liquidity is $82k against a $103k market cap, which is unusually deep. 100% of the LP is unlocked. One unlabeled wallet holds 34.4% of supply, and GMGN flags 26 bundler wallets. Price is up about 327% in the pool's 27 minutes of life, but down 14-22% over the last 5 minutes, below its all-time high of 0.000163. There were 2,096 unique buyers against only 93 unique sellers. That lopsided ratio fits people buying the wrong contract by mistake, or bot buying, while a few large holders sell.

narrative.description: The story is an American strategic oil reserve meme. It is clearly strong right now: several same-name tokens trade near $1B market cap. But this token only borrows that story and is not its home.
narrative.why_spreading: The AROS ticker is going viral, so people searching by name or ticker end up buying copies like this one. Attention belongs to the canonical $1B tokens, not this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the identical name and ticker. It is not the first token, not the canonical one, and not even a pump.fun mint.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 other AROS tokens, including QcakAH...pump ($1.07B), DsJDV...pump ($984M, $1.79M volume in the last hour), 57LVT...pump ($982M) and 3DQbz...pump ($405M). Two other non-pump copies already show zero liquidity, which suggests they were already rugged.

authenticity.evidence: This is a copycat launched with a hand-seeded pool and 100% unlocked LP. One non-pool wallet holds 34.4% and 26 bundlers are flagged. Buyers outnumber sellers about 22 to 1, which is the classic pattern of mistaken or bot buys while insiders sell. Two earlier non-pump AROS copies in the packet now have $0 liquidity.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 34% holder could be a legitimate large buyer. The buys could also be organic spillover from the AROS mania.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked: whoever holds the LP can pull liquidity at any time
A single unlabeled wallet holds 34.4% of supply
Non-pump copy of a $1B ticker; earlier copies of the same kind already show zero liquidity
Price already about 37% below its all-time high and falling in the last 5 minutes

structured_output.counterargument: The AROS craze is enormous, with several tokens near $1B. Spillover buying from traders hunting the "next AROS" could send even a copy from $100k to $200k+ in minutes, and liquidity is deep for this size. 2,096 unique buyers is real breadth. If the LP holder decides to milk trading fees rather than rug, a 2x within 6 hours is possible.
